descriptions.notStarted: Jack Barricade has given me the #bMap of Phantom Forest#k that he took from Taggrin.  He explained that he was forced to steal it from Taggrin, who had refused to give it to him even after he'd won it in a bet fair and square.  Now that Jack's made it up to the Crimsonwood Mountain, he's given the map to me for my own use.  Perhaps I should return it to Taggrin?  If I keep it, the map will come in handy while navigating the tricky Phantom Forest, #ballowing me to use the marked shortcuts#k and save time traveling.  But at the same time, there's a part of me that feels that this map still rightfully belongs to Taggrin.  What should I do?  It's a dilemma...
descriptions.inProgress: I told Taggrin that I'd found Jack up the Crimsonwood Mountain, and explained Jack's purpose.  Taggrin was surprised when I offered to return his Map of Phantom Forest to him... and was moved by my gesture. He seems to have warmed up to me, and ask that I return and speak to him. What could he want?
descriptions.completed: In return for making the honorable gesture of returning his map, Taggrin let me in on a secret of his own: he and his band are not bandits at all, but are actually #bRaven Ninjas#k, descendants of the ancient #bShadowknights#k!  They're here to discover what happened to their ancestral Keep and the reason behind the disappearance of Masteria.  As such, Taggrin is offering a bounty on the Keep's unrightful occupiers.  I can now speak to Joko to redeem any #rBadges#k I find off these corrupted warriors (the #rWindraiders#k, the #rStormbreakers#k, the #rFirebrands#k, and the #rNightshadowsRk) for #bmeso bounties#k, and possibly even #bRaven Ninja gear#k!  I can make #bone Badge Bounty Redemption per day#k
